description: This file defines the AccountTransferDTO class, which is a Data Transfer Object for handling account transfer operations within the Fineract system. It encapsulates details such as transaction date, amount, account types and IDs, transfer types, associated loans or savings accounts, and additional metadata required for processing account transfers.

classes.name: AccountTransferDTO
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing details of an account transfer, including transaction data, account info, transfer types, related loans or savings accounts, and additional metadata necessary for processing transfers within the system.

methods.name: AccountTransferDTO (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs an AccountTransferDTO with comprehensive transfer details, including transaction date, amount, account types and IDs, description, locale, date formatter, payment details, transfer types, charge ID, loan installment number, transfer type, transfer details, note, external transaction ID, loans, savings accounts, and flags for regularity and exception handling.

methods.name: AccountTransferDTO (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs an AccountTransferDTO with essential transfer details, including transaction date, amount, account types and IDs, description, locale, date formatter, transfer types, external transaction ID, and associated loans.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction date for the account transfer.

methods.name: getTransactionAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction amount for the account transfer.

methods.name: getFromAccountType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of account from which funds are transferred.

methods.name: getToAccountType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of account to which funds are transferred.

methods.name: getFromAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the source account.

methods.name: getToAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the destination account.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides the description or memo for the transfer.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the locale used for formatting, messages, or interface preferences.

methods.name: getFmt
methods.description: Retrieves the date formatter used to format transaction dates.

methods.name: getPaymentDetail
methods.description: Retrieves associated payment detail information.

methods.name: getFromTransferType
methods.description: Retrieves the transfer type identifier for the source account.

methods.name: getToTransferType
methods.description: Retrieves the transfer type identifier for the destination account.

methods.name: getChargeId
methods.description: Retrieves the charge ID associated with the transfer, if any.

methods.name: getLoanInstallmentNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the installment number for loan-related transfers.

methods.name: getTransferType
methods.description: Retrieves the general transfer type identifier.

methods.name: getAccountTransferDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information related to the account transfer.

methods.name: getNoteText
methods.description: Retrieves any notes associated with the transfer.

methods.name: getTxnExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves the external transaction ID.

methods.name: getLoan
methods.description: Retrieves the Loan object associated with the transfer.

methods.name: getFromLoan
methods.description: Retrieves the source Loan object, if any.

methods.name: getToLoan
methods.description: Retrieves the destination Loan object, if any.

methods.name: getToSavingsAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the destination SavingsAccount object, if any.

methods.name: getFromSavingsAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the source SavingsAccount object, if any.

methods.name: isRegularTransaction
methods.description: Indicates whether the transfer is a regular transaction.

methods.name: isExceptionForBalanceCheck
methods.description: Indicates if the transfer is an exception for balance checking.
